# Sahaj Saliya

> AI / ML Engineer. Building agentic AI, retrieval systems and LLM applications that reason, cite and correct themselves.

I'm a B.Tech ICT student at PDEU (CGPA 8.5) who designs production-shaped AI systems: multi-agent RAG with corrective loops, reinforcement-learning agents and explainable ML platforms. Most recently I built reusable LLM infrastructure (LLM gateway, RAG runtime, memory layer) for 6G research at HNNOIX. I'm a problem-solver who thrives on creativity and continuous learning.

Status: Open to AI/ML internships & full-time roles from 2027
Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India

## Experience
- Research & Innovation Intern, HNNOIX India Private Limited (May 2026–Jul 2026): Worked on 6G research and development across network architectures, AI agents and communication systems. Built reusable AI components — LLM Gateway, RAG Runtime, AI Memory Layer and Knowledge Base — enabling scalable agent execution, context management and workflow orchestration. Shipped Generative AI, LLM, RAG and agent-based solutions for context-aware retrieval and decision-making in 6G systems.
- Freelance Financial AI Engineer, Quantitative Investment Analysis (Dec 2024–Jun 2025): Developed 2 autonomous trading-signal systems using Agentic AI and RAG that read market news, extract sentiment and emit structured, actionable signals in real time. Cut false-positive trade signals by 37% with filtering rules and confidence scoring. Built a CrewAI research pipeline on GPT-4, Bloomberg API, Financial Modeling Prep and Alpha Vantage for automated earnings analysis.
- AI/ML Core-Committee Member, Encode PDEU (Aug 2023–Jul 2025): Two years on the AI/ML committee — sub-committee member (2023–24), then core committee (2024–25) — running workshops and student AI projects.
- Data Management Analyst, Swaminarayan Temple Kundaldham & Karelibaug (May 2024–Jul 2024): Managed organisational server data: synchronisation, scheduled backups, storage, data security and recovery — keeping data available, consistent and safe.

## Featured projects
- [Enterprise Agentic RAG Orchestrator](https://github.com/SahajIVVIX-1/Multi-Agent-RAG): A production-grade multi-agent RAG system. A supervisor routes each query to Corrective RAG, NL-to-SQL or human-in-the-loop email tools, and a validator grades the answer before it ships. Results: 0.81 Faithfulness, 1.00 Context precision, <1 ms Semantic cache.
- [OpenEnv — RL Data-Cleaning Agent](https://github.com/SahajIVVIX-1/open-env-nuclei): A custom Q-learning environment in which a Llama 3 agent picks cleaning actions for noisy tabular data. Shaped rewards favour fewer missing values and duplicates, and anti-loop penalties stop destructive edits. Results: Q-learning Policy, Docker HF Spaces, Pydantic Typed I/O.
- [Explainable Student Performance Platform](https://github.com/SahajIVVIX-1/student-performance-platform): End-to-end MLOps: Pandera validation, automated feature engineering, and benchmarks across 9 models. SHAP and LIME attributions are compared with Spearman rank correlation to measure how much the explanations agree. Results: 9 Models compared, SHAP+LIME Attribution, MLflow Tracking.
